note: Coerce every request value used in the query filter to a string, every field and not only the one the exploit used, so an object such as {"$ne": null} cannot become an operator.
before:
const { username, password } = req.body;
const user = await User.findOne({ username, password });
after:
const { username, password } = req.body;
const user = await User.findOne({ username: String(username), password: String(password) });

note: With Mongoose, wrap the whole filter in mongoose.sanitizeFilter, which neutralizes operator keys coming from the request.
Reduce the request-controlled segment to its base name before joining it to the base directory, so ../ sequences cannot leave it.
